label: nitrate reduction I (denitrification)
description: 'Complete native nitrate-to-dinitrogen route with five listed objects: vectorial Nar nitrate
  reduction, nitrate/nitrite exchange, c551-dependent nitrite reduction, cytochrome-c-dependent NO reduction
  and N2O reduction. PAO1 experiments support the respiratory system; strict NarK2 antiport versus uniport
  remains unresolved, so native antiport is explicitly a database convention and has no assigned PAO1
  catalyst. Whole carrier classes and side-specific proton coefficients are retained without choosing
  a quinone species or a unique NosZ donor. Functional gene-product edges do not imply isolated subunit
  catalysis. Other-species native complex IDs are not transferred; NirS/NosZ dimer and Nar/Nor assembly
  annotations retain source-specific evidence tiers. Current NorB proton-pump annotation conflicts with
  cNOR structural evidence and is excluded; RCSB 3O0R has source-PAO1 protein sequences differing from
  current entries. Inferred cofactors retain their evidence tiers; ligand-state IDs do not fix catalytic
  redox state. Native background nitrite-to-ammonium prose, Nap compensation, qNOR variants, assimilatory
  reduction, electron-carrier regeneration and ATP synthesis are outside this selected route.'
